Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-college-football-data` skill for accessing CollegeFootballData through the OOMOL `college_football_data` connector.
- Provides read-only actions for account status, including patron level and remaining API calls.
- Supports listing conferences, teams, venues, and games/results from CollegeFootballData.
